label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Jason Day Withdraws
items.text: Jason Day withdrew from the 2026 Rocket Classic due to a persistent back injury, marking his second straight pre-tournament withdrawal and putting his FedExCup playoff chances at risk as he sits 74th with two weeks left.

items.headline: Travelers Joins Tour’s Top Tier
items.text: The Travelers Championship will be part of the PGA TOUR’s new top-tier Championship Series starting in 2028, solidifying TPC River Highlands as a premier event with the biggest fields and purses on the schedule.

items.headline: LIV Golf’s Future Uncertain
items.text: LIV Golf may lose key national-open markets and Official World Golf Ranking points after the PGA Tour’s new partnership with the Asian Tour, potentially hitting its investor appeal as CEO Scott O’Neil seeks new funding.
